title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

title: Manager, IT – BRM (HR)
description:
**Mission of the Role**
 This is a hands\-on leadership role for a practitioner who understands HR from the inside out. The Manager, IT – BRM (HR) serves as the primary technology partner to the HR function – someone who can sit in a compensation review or a talent calibration session, understand what’s being discussed, and translate that directly into system solutions. You will own the full HR technology stack, drive implementations, lead a small team of IT professionals, and act as the trusted advisor who bridges the gap between people strategy and technology execution.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Technical Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* 7\+ years of progressive IT experience with at least 4 years in a hands\-on HR technology role – configuring, implementing, and supporting HCM platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, DarwinBox, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated functional HR knowledge across at least three domains: talent acquisition, core HR/HRIS, compensation \& benefits, payroll, learning \& development, or workforce management.
* Proven track record of personally leading end\-to\-end HCM implementations or major module rollouts in a global, multi\-country environment.
* Strong project and program management skills; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with HR system integrations, middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Dell Boomi), and HR data reporting/analytics tools.
* Familiarity with HR compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, pay equity regulations, statutory reporting) and how they translate into system configuration.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of HR technology trends including AI\-driven talent tools, skills\-based workforce management, and HR process automation (RPA/AI).
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with HR business leaders and translate operational HR needs into actionable technical solutions.
* Continuous improvement mindset (LEAN/Agile) with a track record of simplifying HR processes through technology.


**Key Accountabilities / How You Will Spend Your Days**
**Hands\-On HR Technology Delivery**
* Serve as a subject\-matter expert and active practitioner on core HCM platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, DarwinBox)
* Lead and personally contribute to HCM transformation projects – from blueprint and design workshops through configuration, UAT, cutover, and hypercare – with direct accountability for system quality.
* Own end\-to\-end HR technology processes across the employee lifecycle: talent acquisition, onboarding, compensation, benefits, payroll, learning \& development, performance management, and offboarding.
* Perform business process analysis alongside HR stakeholders, documenting current\-state workflows, identifying gaps, and designing improved future\-state configurations.


**Deep HR Functional Partnership**
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Payroll teams – attending functional meetings, understanding operational pain points, and proactively proposing technology solutions.
* Act as the primary escalation point for HR system issues; investigate root causes, engage vendors as needed, and drive resolution with urgency and transparency.
* Translate HR policy and regulatory changes (e.g., pay equity, compliance reporting, new benefit structures) into system requirements and actionable configuration changes.
* Champion data integrity across HR systems – establishing data governance standards, audit routines, and remediation processes in collaboration with HR operations teams.
* Support workforce analytics by ensuring HR data structures, reporting hierarchies, and BI integrations are accurate, timely, and meaningful for HR and business leaders.


**Project \& Portfolio Management**
* Manage the HR IT project portfolio with discipline: scope definition, resource planning, risk management, status reporting, and stakeholder communication – keeping projects on time, within budget, and delivering measurable outcomes.
* Define and maintain a rolling HR technology roadmap, prioritizing investments based on business value, HR strategy alignment, and total cost of ownership.
* Conduct rigorous cost\-benefit analyses for new system investments, upgrades, and vendor decisions, presenting clear business cases to IT and HR leadership.
* Lead post\-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and continuously improve delivery practices.


**Vendor \& Contract Management**
* Own vendor relationships for HR technology platforms and third\-party integrations – managing SLAs, escalating performance issues, and negotiating contract renewals with a value\-for\-money mindset.
* Evaluate new HR technology vendors and solutions with structured RFP/RFI processes, personally assessing demos and conducting reference checks to make informed recommendations.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Lead and mentor a team of HR IT analysts and developers, providing technical guidance, code/configuration reviews, and career development support.
* Build team capability in HR functional knowledge alongside technical skills – ensuring the IT team understands what HR does, not just how the system works.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and learning from both successes and failures.


**Technology Innovation \& Process Improvement**
* Stay current with HR technology trends – AI\-driven talent intelligence, skills\-based workforce tools, RPA, and employee experience platforms – and pilot relevant innovations in a structured, value\-focused way.
* Identify and lead process automation opportunities across HR operations, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy.
* Drive adoption of deployed tools through targeted training, user enablement, and change management activities developed in close collaboration with HR leadership.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* 95% of projects delivered on time and within budget.
* Achieve a project success rate of 90% based on defined project objectives.
* Improve application uptime and availability.
* Reduction in application\-related incidents by 20%.
* Adherence to the IT budget with a variance of less than 5%.
* Achieve a team satisfaction score of 85% or higher in annual surveys.
* Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks and vulnerabilities.
* Upgrade outdated, unsupportive IT Infrastructure \& Software, supporting Finance and HR operations, with latest technology to improve system uptime and availability to 99%.


**Key Year One Deliverables**
* Complete a thorough audit of the existing HR technology landscape, documenting gaps, risks, and quick\-win improvement opportunities.
* Establish a trusted partnership with the CHRO and HR leadership team, becoming the go\-to advisor for technology decisions.
* Drive at least one significant HR technology improvement (e.g., HCM module implementation, process automation, or integration) from design through go\-live.
* Publish a 3\-year HR IT roadmap aligned to HR and business strategy.
* Implement operational governance practices for HR system support, change management, and release management.


**Key Leadership Behaviors**
* Lead from the front – models accountability, transparency, and a growth mindset for the IT\-HR team.
* Stakeholder Management – builds deep trust with CHRO, HR Business Partners, and People leadership as a strategic advisor.
* Drives Innovation \& Focus – champions AI, automation, and emerging HR tech to improve workforce outcomes and employee experience.
* Employee \& HR Customer Obsession – places the employee experience at the center of every technology decision and service delivery model.
* Business Acumen – understands HR operating models, workforce economics, and people strategy to ensure IT solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Critical thinking \& problem solving – applies structured analytical thinking to navigate complex HR technology landscapes and competing organizational priorities.

**Job Title: Sales HR Manager FMCG** 




**Location:** 
 Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



**Industry:** 
 FMCG / Consumer Goods
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources Sales HR / HRBP
 



**Reports To:** 
 Head HR / Business Head
 



**Experience:** 
 Minimum 7\-10 years, preferably with strong FMCG Sales HR experience
 



**Qualification:** 
 MBA / PGDM / MSW in Human Resources or equivalent
 



**CTC: Minimum Gross CTC 5 LPA to 8 LPA** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 The role will be responsible for
 **sales recruitment, manpower planning, employee engagement, performance management, retention, sales incentives, HR operations and capability development** 
 , while ensuring strong alignment between people practices and business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Sales Recruitment \& Manpower Planning** 



* Partner with Sales leadership to understand manpower requirements and workforce plans.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for
 **Sales Executives, Territory Sales Officers, Sales Officers, Area Sales Managers, Regional Sales Managers and other sales positions** 
 .
* Build a strong talent pipeline for frontline sales positions.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies within agreed recruitment TAT.
* Conduct interviews and assess candidates for functional and behavioural competencies.
* Drive effective onboarding and induction of new sales employees.



**2\. Sales HR Business Partnering** 



* Act as the HR Business Partner for the Sales function.
* Work closely with Sales Heads, Regional Managers and Area Sales Managers on people\-related matters.
* Understand field\-level challenges and provide practical HR solutions.
* Support manpower productivity, organization structure and workforce planning.
* Regularly interact with field sales teams and understand employee concerns.



**3\. Performance Management** 



* Drive implementation of KRAs, KPIs and performance management processes for sales teams.
* Monitor sales\-force productivity and identify performance gaps.
* Support managers in performance reviews and Performance Improvement Plans.
* Track high performers and support talent development and succession planning.
* Partner with Sales leadership to improve overall employee productivity.



**4\. Sales Incentives \& Rewards** 



* Coordinate with management on sales incentive schemes and performance\-linked rewards.
* Ensure accurate and timely incentive calculations and payouts.
* Review incentive effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Drive Reward \& Recognition initiatives for high\-performing sales employees.



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Retention** 



* Develop employee engagement initiatives for frontline and field sales teams.
* Monitor sales employee attrition and identify key reasons for turnover.
* Develop retention initiatives for critical positions and high performers.
* Conduct employee connect programs, feedback sessions and engagement activities.
* Handle employee grievances and facilitate timely resolution.



**6\. Learning \& Development** 



* Identify training and capability gaps within the Sales organization.
* Coordinate product, selling skills, leadership and behavioural training programs.
* Support onboarding and induction programs for new sales employees.
* Work with Sales leadership to build career development plans for high\-potential employees.



**7\. HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure implementation of HR policies and processes across the Sales function.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HRMS data.
* Monitor attendance, leave, transfers, promotions and employee movements.
* Coordinate payroll, incentives and other employee\-related processes.
* Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Prepare and present HR MIS covering manpower, hiring, attrition, productivity and other key metrics.



**8\. Field HR \& Business Connect** 



* Regularly travel to markets/territories to connect with field sales employees and managers.
* Understand ground\-level people challenges and resolve them in coordination with business leaders.
* Support disciplinary and employee relations matters wherever required.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies across locations.

 The ideal candidate should have:
 


* Minimum 7\-10 years of overall HR experience, preferably with
 **3\+ years in Sales HR / HRBP roles** 
 .
* Strong experience in
 **FMCG / Consumer Goods / Retail / Distribution** 
 environments.
* Hands\-on experience managing frontline sales recruitment.
* Good understanding of sales\-force structure, distributor/channel operations and field HR challenges.
* Experience in performance management, sales incentives and employee retention.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Good analytical ability with strong Excel/HRMS skills.
* Willingness to travel within Tamil Nadu and other assigned markets.
* **Tamil proficiency is essential; Hindi would be an added advantage.**

 Candidates currently working as:

 Candidates from FMCG, Food \& Beverage, Consumer Products, Personal Care, Retail or Distribution\-led organizations.
